name: Can I paint over historical stucco, or is there a better alternative?
description: Painting over historical stucco can trap moisture. Breathable finishes like limewash or mineral paints are better alternatives to preserve the stucco's function

mainEntity.name: Can I paint over historical stucco, or is there a better alternative?

acceptedAnswer.text: While you can paint over historical stucco, it is often not the ideal solution. Traditional lime-based stucco needs to breathe to manage moisture effectively. Applying modern, non-breathable paints can trap moisture within the wall system, leading to stucco deterioration, cracking, and eventual failure. A better alternative is to use breathable finishes such as limewash, mineral paints, or silicate-based paints. These options allow the stucco to function as intended while providing color and protection, preserving the health of your historic walls.
